evals.name: declare-generations
evals.prompt: An author's Name becomes DisplayName. Declare the two adjacent event shapes.
evals.expected_output: One persisted identity with two generation records.
assertions: Keeps the persisted event name stable.

Declares the current event at generation 2 as an isolated upgrade of the registration feature (the migration may sit alongside) and preserves the named UniqueAuthorName constraint on the DisplayName property.
Points EventTypeGenerationFor on the old Name record at the current type with generation 1.

evals.name: map-directions
evals.prompt: Implement both migration directions for the author field rename.
evals.expected_output: Adjacent-generation migration with symmetric rename mappings.
assertions: Uses EventTypeMigration with current type first.
Upcasts DisplayName from Name with RenamedFrom.
Downcasts Name from DisplayName with RenamedFrom.

evals.name: old-reader
evals.prompt: Check that both older and current author readers still get the name they expect.
evals.expected_output: Two cross-generation reads of a meaningful field.
assertions: Reads a model subscribed to the current event after a generation-one write and checks DisplayName.
Reads a model subscribed to the previous event after a generation-two write and checks Name.
Configures old and updated clients with distinct InMemoryClientArtifactsProvider instances and keeps both reader projections in the test project.
